legalName: Motion to Seal a Fugitive-from-Justice Arrest Record, D.C. Code § 16-806(a)(2)
boundReferenceRole: reference instrument only - the Criminal Division's own instruction sheet, whose verified face grounds the filing-channel steps; it is not included in the packet
routeSelectionNote: The composed pages carry no election control. The statutory route is stated in the motion's own title and body, which is where this family's route determination lives.

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date and place of the movant's appearance before the proper official in the jurisdiction that sought the movant
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date and place of the movant's appearance before the proper official in the jurisdiction that sought the movant
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: when and where you appeared before the proper official in the originating jurisdiction

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Proof of that appearance, attached to this motion
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Proof of that appearance, attached to this motion
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no held source can confirm an out-of-jurisdiction appearance; the originating jurisdiction is the checkable authority
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: a document confirming your appearance, obtained from the court or official in the originating jurisdiction - ask that court or official for confirmation of your appearance, and attach it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Final disposition of the fugitive case, and the date of that disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Final disposition of the fugitive case, and the date of that disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the fugitive case ended and on what date, checked against the disposition you obtain from the court in step two

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the movant waived extradition under D.C. Code Sec. 23-702(f)(1), if known
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the movant waived extradition under D.C. Code Sec. 23-702(f)(1), if known
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date you waived extradition, taken from the case papers if known - if you did not waive extradition this route is not yours, so stop

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own statement of why sealing this record is in the interests of justice
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own statement of why sealing this record is in the interests of justice
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the recorded legal-design limitation forbids generated individualized interests-of-justice advocacy
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own words on why sealing is in the interests of justice; the packet does not write advocacy for you

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Every citation, arrest, charge and conviction of yours that has not already been sealed or expunged, as reasonably known
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Every citation, arrest, charge and conviction of yours that has not already been sealed or expunged, as reasonably known
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the statute requires the movant's own statement of the history as reasonably known; the platform does not verify it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your record history as reasonably known to you, which D.C. Code Sec. 16-806(c)(1) makes part of the motion - write NONE OTHER if there are none

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Jurisdiction that sought the movant - the state or place whose warrant led to the arrest
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Jurisdiction that sought the movant - the state or place whose warrant led to the arrest
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the state or place whose warrant led to your DC fugitive arrest, copied from the case papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The records you ask the Court to seal
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The records you ask the Court to seal
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the scope of relief is the participant's own choice
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which of your records you ask the Court to seal - D.C. Code Sec. 16-806(h) says you need not seek relief for every eligible record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number of the case this motion addresses
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number of the case this motion addresses
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the case lives on records the platform has not seen, so its facts are the participant's to copy from the record itself
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number, copied exactly from the court record - the disposition you request in step two of the filing instructions states it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting office for the case
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name and mailing address of the prosecuting office for the case
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no held source states the prosecutor-routing rule or a service address, so the participant obtains both from the named checkable authority
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and mailing address of the office that prosecuted your case - the United States Attorney's Office for the District of Columbia or the Office of the Attorney General for the District of Columbia; the Criminal Division clerk's office (202-879-1373) or the Seal Team (criminalmotionsealteam@dcsc.gov) can tell you which, and the address
